scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -k -n "SERVER,DESKTOP" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:desktop
scripts.clean:build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['apps/desktop/dist', 'target/release'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })); console.log('Build artifacts cleaned.');"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['node_modules', 'apps/desktop/node_modules', 'apps/desktop/dist', 'target'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })); console.log('Workspace cleaned to fresh state.');"
